newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end off, seen consolidating.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end off, seen consolidating.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures recouped most of their losses but ended slightly lower on Tuesday after failing to make a conclusive break on the upside.
Nikkei 225 March futures ended 15 points lower at 20,405 after hitting a high of 20,245. Volume was a thin 12,150 lots.

"The Nikkei will move sideways to possibly down until it manages to close above 20,550," said a trader with a local institution. He said a close above that level would signal a change in the short-term down trend.
He said trade was thin and driven largely by intra-day scalping as most position players preferred to stay out of quiet year-end markets.
A trader with a Japanese house said sentiment remained weak on the Nikkei and players were likely to sell it on any rises towards 20,600, but 20,150-20,200 should limit the downside for the week.

"Most market participants will get out of any long positions before the end of the year in case anything happens in U.S. markets during the Japanese holidays," he said, noting that Japan had several holidays over the next three weeks.
